name: doodad-snap-custom-alpha
description: Snap Doodads on Load, doodads whose pathing texture is a 32-bit 4x4 file of the map of one colour whose alpha varies (magenta with half, one pixel or a ring transparent; red and black with half transparent), each at two angles (doodads 0-9; fixtures/we-specs/make-doodad-snap.mjs alpha): does the editor's mixed-picture rule look at the alpha (test.md)? KNOWN DIFFERENCE (2026-11-14, two runs): the editor turns all five to the quarter (doodads[0].angle 0, doodads[1] 1.5707964), as a picture of more than one colour; Studio keeps their angles (0.4, 1.2: doodadgrid.ts mixedPicture ignores alpha)

steps.eval: const s = await w3.services.get('w3.terrain'); for (let i = 0; i < 60 && !s.placedObjects()?.doodads?.length; i++) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500)); window.__driveEd.pushEdit({ undo() {}, redo() {}, terrain: false, objects: false });
